name: max-over-phrases-last-phrase-best
note: a concept's score is the highest cosine over its phrases, not the first or the average; the query is close to the second phrase 'fixes bugs' (cosine ~0.995) and nearly orthogonal to the first, so the max comes from phrase two

name: max-over-phrases-first-phrase-best
note: a concept's score is the highest cosine over its phrases; the query is close to the first phrase 'writes code' (cosine ~0.995) and nearly orthogonal to the second, so the max comes from phrase one

name: weak-similarity-below-threshold
note: a query only weakly related to either phrase scores about 0.19, under the 0.6 threshold, so the rule misses and routing falls back to default_model

name: negative-cosine-floored-to-zero
note: a query pointing opposite to the phrases has negative cosines (about -0.71 to each), but the concept score is floored at 0, so it scores exactly 0 rather than a negative value and the rule misses

name: inclusive-boundary
note: the query's best cosine is exactly the min_score of 0.6 (dot 3 over norm 5), and the band is inclusive, so it matches

name: phrase-dimension-mismatch-fails-whole-concept
note: A concept scores the max cosine over its phrases, but one uncomparable phrase fails the whole classifier instead of falling back to the usable ones. 'writes code' matches the input exactly (cosine 1.0, well over the 0.6 threshold) while 'fixes bugs' has a different vector length, so the classifier reports failure, on_error defaults to match_false, and the trace entry carries no score.
